note: Last-author surname -> training/co-authorship lineage id, for leave-one-lineage-out holdouts and for lineage-clustered bootstrap. Bibliographic knowledge only: who trained with whom and who publishes together. It encodes no anatomical outcome and no claim about any result. Pooling rule applied: a lineage is the senior author's own doctoral or postdoctoral parent within this field, EXCEPT that a lab independent long enough to have trained its own cohort gets its own id (so Reddien, Newmark, Rink, Petersen, Pearson, Salo, Bartscherer and Aboobaker are their own lineages rather than being folded into Sanchez Alvarado). Levin trainees and Marchant trainees are pooled as instructed. Surnames whose lineage is uncertain, and ambiguous or very common surnames, get their own id rather than a guess. Keys are lower case; accented spellings are listed beside their ASCII forms because the harness strips non-ASCII characters when canonicalising. A surname absent from this map is its own lineage by default in harness/derive_features.py, and the count of unmapped labs is printed as lab_not_in_lineage_map. Two deliberate choices a reviewer should know about: (1) pooling trainees with their parent lab reduces the number of independent clusters, which makes UNTESTABLE verdicts more likely but prevents one lineage from counting as several confirmations; (2) Cebria trained in both Barcelona and Kyoto and is assigned to the Barcelona lineage. v2: adds khokha as its own lineage (a long-independent Xenopus lab with its own trainees; under the pooling rule above it is not folded into its postdoctoral parent). v3: adds the three setup-pass labs missing from v2 and reviews two early assignments. annand -> mccaig (the 2014 Aberdeen PhD thesis on endogenous/applied electric fields in planarians; Aberdeen's electric-field lab is McCaig's, with which Zhao is already pooled). buchanan -> child and rustia -> child (both are Chicago-school planarian papers of the 1920s using Child's species, his method of levels and his head-frequency scoring; pooling them with Child keeps one research programme from counting as three confirmations). hyman -> child, changed from its own id: Libbie Hyman took her doctorate with Child and worked as his research associate, and her planarian gradient papers belong to that programme. dubois -> wolff, changed from its own id: Francine Dubois's doctoral work was done with Etienne Wolff at Strasbourg and their neoblast papers are joint. Reviewed and deliberately left with their own ids for want of a documented parent in this field: lund, rose, borgens (doctoral work at Purdue with Vanable, who is absent from this map), flickinger, chandebois, jenkins, goss, stocum, brondsted. All five v3 assignments reduce the number of independent clusters, which makes UNTESTABLE verdicts more likely rather than less.
